name: Functional Alcoholism
desc: Better alcohol tolerance; evening drinks make the next morning harder.
plays: Alcohol tolerance rises; evening drinks cause a morning hangover and can strengthen social trust.

name: Reply-All Reflex
desc: One reply in four reaches everyone. Recall it before the block ends.
plays: One in four replies goes to everyone unless recalled for 1 DP; missed instructions hurt more.

name: Pathologically Punctual
desc: Arrives before the meeting is scheduled.
plays: Extra stamina improves DP and overnight recovery, but impatience reduces charm.

name: Brussels Brain
desc: Speaks only in acronyms. Nobody understands you.
plays: Formal instructions earn more HQ goodwill, but low charm weakens positive relationship gains.

name: Compulsive Démarche
desc: Cannot pass a ministry without delivering something.
plays: Formal choices earn more HQ goodwill, but missed instructions are harder to explain away.

name: Name-dropper
plays: Dropping names helps with host officials but damages your standing with Ruth whenever used.

name: Allergic to Local Cuisine
plays: Lower charm reduces positive social and contact trust gains.

name: Secret Novelist
desc: A gift for plausible stories, at the expense of stamina.
plays: Higher deniability softens missed instructions, but lower stamina reduces recovery.

name: Cannot Say No to Side Events
desc: Your calendar is a side event.
plays: Low stamina limits DP and recovery while charm improves positive relationship gains.

name: Sleeps With Eyes Open
plays: Extra stamina improves DP and recovery, but reduced charm weakens relationship gains.

name: Spouse Runs a Local NGO
plays: Charm improves relationship gains, while lower deniability worsens missed instructions.
